beats.event: Basil paints Dorian's portrait; Lord Henry meets and captivates him
Under Henry's influence, Dorian wishes the portrait would age in his place
Dorian discovers actress Sibyl Vane, courts her, and proposes marriage
Sibyl calls him 'Prince Charming'; brother James vows vengeance if harmed
Sibyl performs poorly onstage; Dorian cruelly rejects her
Dorian sees a subtle sneer of cruelty appear on the portrait
Lord Henry brings news that Sibyl has killed herself
Dorian locks portrait away; enjoys 18 years of ageless vice
Basil confronts Dorian about rumors; is shown the hideous portrait
Enraged, Dorian stabs Basil to death in the locked room
Dorian blackmails Alan Campbell to destroy body; Alan later kills himself
Fleeing guilt to an opium den, Dorian is accosted by James Vane
Dorian's young face deceives James, who releases him
A woman confirms Dorian's identity; James begins stalking him
At a shooting party a hunter accidentally kills James Vane
Dorian resolves to reform and spares Hetty Merton's heart
Portrait grows uglier still, revealing his motives are vanity, not remorse
Dorian stabs the portrait; found as a withered corpse, painting restored
